subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice-only path request — Solstice Analytics trial
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@solsticeanalytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@solsticeanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice-only path request — Solstice Analytics trial

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Solstice team is excited to proceed with the 3-week pilot. Our finance team operates on a primarily invoice-driven cadence (no purchase order system) and we'd like to confirm whether Redwood can accommodate an invoice-only onboarding for the duration of the pilot.

Practical asks:
- Short-term exception: invoice-only billing for 30–90 days while our AP configures a PO system.
- Standard evidence: W-9, COI (insurance), and a signed vendor onboarding form — we can attach these.
- Billing cadence: Net 30 preferred.

If there are specific forms or a waiver you need from us to qualify for a temporary no-PO path, let me know and I will route them internally for signature. We are aiming to start the pilot next Monday (6/26) if possible.

Attaching W-9 and insurance for your intake team (see filenames below).

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Vendor Operations | Solstice Analytics
maya@solsticeanalytics.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: W-9_Solstice.pdf, InsuranceCert_Solstice.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@solsticeanalytics.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice-only path request — Solstice Analytics trial

Hi Maya — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the W-9 and insurance cert. Looping in Priyom (procurement/policy) and Marissa (vendor onboarding) to confirm the temporary invoice-only intake.

High level: Redwood does require POs for standard supplier relationships, but we do have an established short-term invoice-only carveout for trials and low-dollar pilots with an evidence checklist and expiration window. Priyom — could you confirm the maximum pilot window we can allow without a PO, and any gating items we should capture now?

Maya — once we confirm, Marissa will send the vendor onboarding form for signature and a short waiver to document the exception (internal approvals + evidence). If we can turn this around this week we should be able to retain your 6/26 start date.

Sooj

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice-only path request — Solstice Analytics trial

Soojin / Marissa — thanks for the tag. Quick policy summary:

- Standard rule: PO required for all vendor relationships with recurring spend or commitments.
- Short-term carveout: invoice-only allowed for trials or pilots up to 90 days and $25k gross spend cap, subject to evidence and a signed internal exception.
- Required intake items for carveout: W-9, COI (certificate of insurance), completed vendor onboarding form, and an exceptions waiver signed by Sales + Finance.
- Billing cadence accepted: Net 30; payment terms beyond Net 30 require Finance approval.
- Additional gating: any access to production data or integrations needs Security sign-off — but for a sandbox pilot that's usually not necessary.

Action items for this thread:
1) Ask Solstice to complete the vendor onboarding form and return it (Marissa can send).
2) Sales (Soojin) to get agreement on the 90-day window and $25k cap from Solstice — if they expect higher spend, we need to route to Procurement + Finance for a PO exception.
3) I will prepare the internal exception form and loop in Finance for signature.

Marissa — can you drop the onboarding form and a short waiver (one page) to Maya? I'll prep the internal approval stack once Solstice confirms the pilot scope.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Program Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Maya Singh <maya@solsticeanalytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@solsticeanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice-only path request — Solstice Analytics trial

Hi Soojin / Priyom — perfect, thanks for the clear summary. We confirm the pilot will be strictly evaluation-only (sandbox), expected spend ~ $3k–5k over three weeks, so well under the threshold. Net 30 is fine.

We completed the vendor onboarding form and attached it here, plus the W-9 and insurance which I included earlier. We can sign the waiver — please send and we'll return it same day.

We also have a signed purchase confirmation for internal purposes (not a PO) and a primary AP contact who will receive invoices: ap@solsticeanalytics.com.

Looking forward to the kickoff next Monday.

Best,
Maya

Attachments: VendorOnboardForm_Filled.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice-only path request — Solstice Analytics trial

Thanks all — copying the agreed next steps here so we have a clear record and I can start processing intake: 

- Solstice (external) has provided W-9, COI, and completed the onboarding form (attachments verified).
- Agreed carveout: invoice-only pilot for up to 90 days, $25k cap; Net 30.
- AP contact for invoices: ap@solsticeanalytics.com.
- Marissa to send the one-page vendor exception waiver (signature: Solstice + Sales + Procurement).
- Priyom will file the internal approval (Procurement + Finance) once the waiver is returned.
- Security: sandbox-only — no prod credentials needed; no additional security clearance required.

I will create the vendor record in our system and flag it as a temporary "invoice-only" allowlist item expiring on 2028-09-17 (90 days). Please confirm if you want the expiration shorter.

Soojin — please capture the HubSpot deal ID and add the expected pilot ARR to the deal so Finance has a record. I linked the internal ticket PROC-4217 for the approval trail.

I'll attach the waiver draft in my next email; Solstice, please sign and return and we'll finalize the internal signoffs.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
